title: Participants’ testimonials
description: Quotes, memories and experiences from past editions of Battle for Middle-earth.
subtitle: What those who were already in Middle-earth take away.
alert_pre: We are gradually collecting testimonials from participants. If you’d like to share yours, write us at
q1_text: I came for the first time and by day two I belonged to the crew. The Saturday battle was the most intense experience of the year.
q2_text: When my daughter saw the elves give her a flower crown by the evening fire, I knew we were coming back.
q3_text: Friday in the camp had an atmosphere I can’t describe. Coins, the pub, bargaining — that was exactly it.
cta_body: A year from now you could have your own memory — maybe even your own quote on this page.
